run_setup_densepose: run the setup.py to install detectron2-densepose and its dependencies
get_detectron2_version: get the current detectron2 version by parsing the __init__.py file with regex
install_densepose_package: install the detectron2-densepose package with av, opencv, and scipy dependencies
